pokedexEntries.sc: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

pokedexEntries.vi: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

pokedexEntries.za: Glimmet clings to the ceilings of caves. It defends itself by striking enemies with its bud, which is packed with poisonous components.
